NoteCrypt combines strong 256-bit AES encryption, and rugged simplicity. NoteCrypt will prevent even the most determined and well-resourced attacker from accessing your notes, even if they physically possess and can unlock your device.

NoteCrypt goes to extreme lengths to secure your notes:
- Applies 256-bit AES encryption to the full notes database
- Uses the PBKDF2 key derivation and stretching function
- Does not store your password, making your notes impossible to decrypt without it
- Does not have cloud integration or login
- Does not use analytics
- Uses 'salt' to prevent 'rainbow table' attacks
- Foils 'known plaintext' attacks by encrypting big blocks of data including metadata
- Erases the in-memory copy of your notes when leaving the app
- Prevents notes showing in the app switcher
- Does not support Touch ID so as to not compromise on security

NoteCrypt also has the following usability features:
- Simple, no-nonsense design
- Provides an indicator on the strength of your password
- Allows you to change your password
- Dark themed UI

In summary, NoteCrypt works the hardest to secure your notes.
